name: Class Symbol
notes: Discussed at the 2026-10-03 Senate (listed under Discussion on that Senate's agenda, matching its Project 2 status); not yet voted on. Refreshed 2026-10-30 under the weekly doc-refresh rule: the document was edited on 2026-10-03 per the Senate discussion into a two-option final voting version ('Both options should be up for a vote'). The previous record reflected Option 1 only, plus a rationale line that does not appear in the current document (the document states no rationale). Two poll blocks are stored — one per option, per the document's own voting instruction; these are alternative options, not designated line items (line_items remains empty).
summary: Final voting version (edited 2026-10-03 per Senate discussion) presenting two options — the document states both options should be up for a vote.

Option 1: add a Chapter 6 rule (before the NPC section) — some spells and skills require touching a Class Symbol with a free hand; the symbol is the player's persona-fitting choice but must be a real physical token (drawn/embroidered does not count) and be approved by a Spell Marshal; also removes 'Symbol' from the class charts.
Option 2: instead remove 'Symbol' references from the Class/Spell/Skill charts, and 'Leaves or herbs' from Herbalism.
Option 2 also rewrites Find/Remove Traps and Open Locks to require an empty hand (replacing the requirement to touch or hold a class symbol).
Option 2 changes Sanctuary: the caster presents 'a Symbol' representing the power they call upon (replacing 'their Holy Symbol').
